# About MENASCO

> For more than three decades, MENASCO has delivered integrated mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire-protection (MEP) engineering solutions that power some of the region's most demanding developments, from Dubai's skyline to mission-critical facilities across the UAE and GCC. Through technical expertise and disciplined project execution, we create reliable infrastructure that stands the test of time.

## Company Overview

MENASCO Mechanical Contracting LLC is one of the UAE's leading providers of integrated MEP engineering and contracting solutions, delivering high-performance building services across commercial, residential, industrial, hospitality, healthcare, infrastructure, and mission-critical developments.

Founded in 1994, MENASCO has earned a reputation for engineering precision, technical excellence, and reliable project delivery. Today, our regional locations continue to grow through MENASCO Misr and MENASCO KSA, allowing us to support clients across the Middle East with consistent quality, innovation, and operational excellence.

Our multidisciplinary teams combine engineering expertise, advanced technologies, and collaborative project management to deliver complete lifecycle MEP solutions, from design coordination and BIM integration through installation, commissioning, and project handover.

## Key Facts

- Established in 1994 in the UAE as MENASCO Mechanical Contracting L.L.C.
- Operates as an integrated MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection) engineering and contracting company.
- 100+ Projects Successfully Delivered
- 32+ Years of Engineering Excellence
- 4 Countries of Operation (United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, United Kingdom)
- 4,000+ Workforce
- Dubai, UAE is MENASCO’s Head Office.
- Regional offices in Riyadh (MENASCO KSA), Cairo (MENASCO Misr), London (United Kingdom).
- Serves sectors including Residential / Commercial, Hospitality, Landmark Entertainment, Advanced Technical Facilities.
- Core service lines include Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Fire Protection, BIM & Digital Engineering, Manufacturing & Prefabrication, alongside dedicated data centre MEP delivery.
- Delivers specialist engineering for data centres, mission-critical, healthcare, energy, and other technically demanding facilities.
- Project-delivery approach incorporates early project engagement, BIM-driven coordination, and disciplined execution.
- Maintains a dedicated Innovation & Technology ecosystem spanning Automatic Tendering Logic Assessment System (ATLAS), LYNXqc, Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation, Enterprise Data Lake, MENASCO Connect.
- Maintains an integrated QHSE system certified to ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018.

## Mission

We transform engineering challenges into practical, high-performance solutions by combining innovation, technical expertise, and uncompromising quality. Through collaboration and continuous improvement, we create lasting value for our clients, partners, employees, and communities.

## Vision

To lead the future of engineering and infrastructure by delivering innovative, sustainable, and reliable MEP solutions that shape smarter communities and lasting built environments.

## Values

- Innovation: Transforming visionary ideas into practical engineering solutions.
- Reliability: Building lasting trust through consistency, accountability, and performance.
- Sustainability: Designing and delivering solutions that support future generations.
- Integrity: Acting with honesty, transparency, and professionalism in everything we do.
- Excellence: Pursuing exceptional quality in every project, every system, and every detail.
- Collaboration: Achieving success through teamwork, partnership, and shared expertise.

## Our Approach

- Early Project Engagement: We work closely with clients and stakeholders from the earliest stages to optimize constructability, reduce project risk, and maximize long-term value.
- BIM-Driven Coordination: Advanced Building Information Modeling enables precise multidisciplinary coordination, minimizing clashes and improving construction efficiency.
- Disciplined Execution: Our structured project management methodology ensures quality, safety, schedule adherence, and cost efficiency throughout every project lifecycle.
- Reliable Delivery: Every solution is engineered to deliver long-term operational performance while meeting the highest international quality standards.
